summary: Frontend-only verification (civr.alice@example.com @ /cloudivr) of (A) OutboundFlow 'Call flow' card on Quick call + New Campaign and (B) inline-editable Call flow tree on a number's Keypad menu (IVR) tab. All requested flows pass. (1) Quick call (/cloudivr/app/quick-call): data-testid='quick-flow' is present. With the form empty, quick-flow-checks lists exactly '3 things to fix before it works' with error rows 'message — Write the script the call reads out.', 'who to call — Add at least one number to call.', 'connect to — Add the phone number people are connected to when they press a key.' After filling '+14155550123', script 'Hi, press 1 to reach us', transfer-to '+14155550100', within ~2s checks flip to 'Ready to place / No problems found.' and the tree reads 'Call 1 number → Message "Hi, press 1 to reach us" → Key 1 Connect +1 (415) 555-0100'. 'Walk through this call' (quick-flow-test-button) returns '5 passed' with rows 'Start · person answers → hears your message', 'Key 1 · press 1 → is connected to +1 (415) 555-0100', 'Other keys', 'No key', 'No answer'. Removing the transfer-to triggers '1 thing to fix — connect to — Add the phone number people are connected to when they press a key.' and the walk-through switches to '4 passed · 1 would fail' with Key 1 row '⚠ no phone to connect to'. Switching mode to OTP with a script that does not say 'press 1' shows 'script — The script must tell the person to press 1 before typing the code.' Switching to menu mode and adding a key via quick-menu-add with action 'Connect to a phone' and empty number shows 'Key 1 — Add the phone number this key should ring (with country code).' plus a warn 'The message doesn't mention key 1'. Filling quick-menu-key-0-forward with '+14155550199' clears the error → 'Ready to place'. (2) New campaign form (/cloudivr/app/campaigns/new, non-AI): data-testid='campaign-flow' is present full width under the assistant. Typing the script via 'campaign-script-text' updates the campaign-flow-tree within ~2s. A script without opt-out wording shows 'message — Consider telling people how to stop these calls (for example "press 9 to stop these calls"). Only call people who agreed...' as a WARNING (card stays 'Ready to save') together with an informational warn 'message — The message doesn't tell people to press 1.' — matches spec (warning, not error). Did NOT submit/save the campaign. (3) IVR editable flow on +13346970100 (?tab=ivr): clicking 'ivr-flow-node-k1-edit' opens ivr-flow-editor with fields ivr-flow-edit-{digit-select,action-select,label-input,forward-input,remove-button}. Typing '+14155550137' character-by-character (type with delay=60ms) kept focus (activeElement data-testid stayed 'ivr-flow-edit-forward-input') and ended with the exact full value; the left builder's ivr-option-0-forward-input updated live to the same value. Changing action to 'Play a message' and typing a message via ivr-flow-edit-message-input updated both the left-side ivr-option-0-action-select to 'message' and the tree node to 'Key 1 · Orders · Message · Welcome to our orders line'. Saved via ivr-save-button, reloaded, and the new forward '+14155550137' persisted (verified by reading ivr-option-0-forward-input after reload). (4) Add/remove: clicking 'ivr-flow-node-greeting-add' added Key 3 as a new top-level key and opened its editor. Changing its action to 'Open a sub-menu' turned the node into a menu; 'ivr-flow-node-k3-add' appeared. Adding a key inside created 'ivr-flow-node-k3.1' and its editor; filling its forward and changing its digit from 1 → 2 kept the editor open and followed the key (new node became 'ivr-flow-node-k3.2-edit'). Clicking the editor's trash (ivr-flow-edit-remove-button) removed the inner key from the tree AND the builder. (5) Restore: used the flow editor to set Key 1 forward back to +14155550100 (removed added Key 3 first via its editor's remove), Saved, reloaded — final persisted state: greeting 'Press 1 for orders, press 2 for our menu by text.', Key 1 action=forward label='Orders' forward='+14155550100', Key 2 action=sms label='Menu'. No extra Key 3 present. IVR enable toggle (ivr-enabled-toggle) is OFF. Regression: live checks (ivr-flow-checks) and ivr-flow-tree still update within ~1.5s of edits made in the left builder; typing in the left builder's inputs works normally and is mirrored into the flow editor.
action_items: (Nice-to-have) The campaign-flow 'press 1' hint is rendered as a warning at the same visual level as the opt-out warning, which is fine, but when transfer mode is on with no transferNumber the user may expect a hard ERROR (not warning). Worth double-checking /outbound/check output on the non-AI 'transfer' kind in Campaigns — I could not easily switch mode via UI because the mode selector is a hidden select behind a custom pill (campaign-mode-select) rendered elsewhere and not exposed as discrete pills; add data-testid on the visible mode pills (e.g. campaign-mode-transfer / campaign-mode-record) for easier automation.
critical_code_review_comments: IvrFlow.js Tree: `node` is a plain function called recursively — React key uniqueness relies on ids being unique across the whole tree, which they are (k1 / k3.2 etc.), but if a (buggy) blueprint ever emits a duplicate id React would silently collapse nodes. Add a visited-set or de-dupe guard before mapping edges.

IvrFlow.js `pathOf` regex `/^k\d(\.\d)*$/` only allows single-digit digits per level, which matches DIGITS (0-9) but assumes the blueprint never emits a 2-char digit. Keep in sync with any future '10' / '#' / '*' support.

IvrTab.js FlowEditor: `set` always writes `setList(mapAt(list, path, ...))` and only updates path when `patch.digit` is set; if the user changes digit while another in-flight set() with a non-digit patch is pending, the two setStates are batched so no issue — but a subtle race is possible if `setPath` is called from the digit branch and a sibling remove deletes that very path before the next render. Low likelihood.

IvrFlow FlowCard: when `edit.canAdd(addTo)` returns false (all 10 digits used), the '+ key' button is simply hidden — the spec allows this but there is no visible hint for the user. Consider a disabled button with tooltip 'No free keys left'.

Campaigns.js visible Mode selector (transfer/record/menu) does not expose discrete pill data-testids (`campaign-mode-transfer` etc.) — only a parent `campaign-mode-select` — this blocks automated testing of the transfer-no-number error path. Add testids.

QuickCall.js menu-mode 'add' button data-testid is `quick-menu-add` (and children `quick-menu-key-N-forward`). This differs from the pattern used elsewhere (`-add-option-button`). Harmless but inconsistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows that could be automated — Emily full chat end-to-end was skipped to preserve tokens; architecture surface (apply, proposal, flow sync) is identical to iteration_303/304 and verified through its testids earlier.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes: Quick call = /cloudivr/app/quick-call ; Campaigns new = /cloudivr/app/campaigns/new. OutboundFlow testids: quick-flow / campaign-flow + their -tree / -checks / -test-button / -test-summary / -test-row-N / -issue-{error|warn}-N / -node-* children. IVR flow editor testids (new): ivr-flow-node-{incoming,greeting,k1,k1.2,...}, ivr-flow-node-greeting-add, ivr-flow-node-k<path>-{edit,add}, ivr-flow-editor (the opened panel), ivr-flow-edit-{digit-select,action-select,label-input,forward-input,message-input,sub-greeting,remove-button,...}. The digit select correctly follows the key when changed (editor stays open, node id morphs e.g. k3.1 → k3.2). Changing action to 'submenu' adds an 'add' slot on that node. Save button ivr-save-button saves the full menu including flow-editor changes; reload re-fetches and shows the persisted state. Quick call script box testid is quick-script (contains a textarea child) ; campaign script text = campaign-script-text but is only visible after clicking the 'Write a script with a template instead' button on the standard-campaign form (campaign-write-script-button). Emily proposal/apply testids follow the pattern from iteration_303: ivr-assist-proposal-<msgIdx>-apply, quick-assist / campaign-assist with modes -mode-chat.
rca of the issue: No defect reproduced. Inline flow editor correctly keeps focus during character-by-character typing (ivr-flow-edit-forward-input stays as document.activeElement), survives digit renames, and its changes persist through Save+reload. OutboundFlow on Quick call and Campaign reflects live checks/tree/walk-through exactly as specced.
